outlook.nextStep: The overnight beats from Nvidia, Salesforce, and CrowdStrike are the biggest near-term catalyst, worth a closer look at whether the AI and software trade can hold its premarket gains through the full session. Friday's Jackson Hole speech from Fed Chair Warsh is probably better watched than acted on until there's more clarity on tone, especially with rate-hike odds still hovering around 45% for December.

signals.title: Nvidia beats Q2 estimates and guides to 70% FY28 revenue growth; reportedly buying Hugging Face
signals.body: Nvidia's fiscal Q2 revenue more than doubled year-over-year and beat forecasts by its largest margin in two years. Shares jumped as much as 6-7% in premarket trading Thursday after CFO Colette Kress guided to roughly 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028. Separately, reports indicate Nvidia has agreed to acquire AI model hub Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion, though this hasn't been officially confirmed by the company.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether the guidance and the reported acquisition mark a durable reacceleration in the AI-infrastructure trade or a one-quarter pop

signals.title: Salesforce surges on Q2 beat, raised guidance, and a $2.6B Anthropic stake gain
signals.body: Salesforce shares jumped as much as 11-14% in after-hours and premarket trading after reporting adjusted EPS of $5.90 (well above estimates) and revenue of $11.35B, while raising full-year guidance to $46.1-46.4B. The results included a roughly $2.6 billion gain tied to its investment stake in Anthropic, and the company unveiled 'Claudeforce,' a new AI product in pilot with select customers ahead of a wider beta next month.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether this reflects durable demand strength or a one-time gain inflating the headline beat

signals.title: CrowdStrike posts a record quarter, raises full-year guidance
signals.body: CrowdStrike beat Q2 revenue and EPS estimates, with net new annual recurring revenue setting a new record and prompting an upgraded outlook. Annual recurring revenue reached $5.84B (up 25.4% year-over-year), and the company guided FY2027 revenue to $5.99-6.01B, above the prior consensus. Shares rose 8-12% in early trading.
signals.focus: worth watching whether the raised guidance holds up through the full session or fades as the initial earnings pop cools, a pattern this stock has shown before

signals.title: Sticky inflation keeps Fed rate-hike odds elevated ahead of Friday's Jackson Hole speech
signals.body: Treasury yields have edged higher after a hotter-than-expected PCE inflation print, with markets now pricing roughly a 45% chance of a Fed rate hike by the December meeting versus about 27% odds rates hold steady. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote on Friday; a recent survey found views split on whether he'll offer clear guidance, with somewhat more economists expecting a hawkish lean than a neutral one.
signals.focus: probably better watched than acted on until there's more clarity from Friday's speech, given how much uncertainty remains about its tone

signals.title: Semiconductor sector broadens out beyond Nvidia after its earnings beat
signals.body: Following Nvidia's report, the wider chip complex rallied, with Marvell up more than 5% and Micron and Arm both up more than 4% in premarket trading, reversing Monday's selloff that had been driven by Micron's Netlist patent headwinds. Semiconductor-focused ETFs (SMH, SOXX) gained 3-3.5% on the news.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether this marks broad-based confirmation of AI-infrastructure demand or is mostly a relief rally tied to one company's report

signals.title: Bitcoin cools slightly after topping $81,000 on Treasury bond-buying news
signals.body: Bitcoin briefly cleared $81,000 this week for the first time in over three months, driven by a surprise US Treasury move to double its long-term bond-buying program. Prices have since eased back toward $78,500-79,000. One widely cited Wall Street forecast now projects Bitcoin could reach $150,000 by mid-2027 in a base case, with a more aggressive scenario citing $500,000 by 2029 if institutional capital accelerates its rotation into the asset.
signals.focus: worth treating the long-range price targets as one analyst's scenario rather than a base-case expectation, and watching whether the current pullback holds above recent support

signals.title: China humanoid-robotics rally cools after this week's bounce
signals.body: UBTECH and the broader China humanoid-robotics complex gave back some of this week's sector-wide bounce today. Meanwhile Tesla continues to build on its robotaxi approvals in Nevada alongside Uber and Waymo, part of the broader autonomous-vehicle and humanoid-robotics buildout narrative.
signals.focus: worth treating single-day swings in individual robotics names as noise relative to the multi-year capital-flow trend into the space
